origin: Existing authored synthetic FWE-030 corpus; prior different-model evaluation disclosed; not independent replication
selection_rule: First 12 of 30 indices sorted by SHA256(UTF8('FAR-REPLAN-001|FWE-' + 3-digit one-based index)); compare raw digest bytes and break ties by index
interruption: On the first attempted solution.py write only, a host-declared, one-shot transient tool error aborts the current worker. Fault is identical across both arms, seeded before allocation; the replanning arm may recover through a distinct budgeted agent invocation.
limitations: The 30 FWE cases were previously run with a separate 1.5B model; the cohort is not fresh independent external evidence.
An agent may learn an existing publicly available corpus; independently exclude contamination before execution.
The documented deterministic transient write failure makes this a mechanism diagnostic rather than typical task sampling.
This candidate is not a frozen cohort and may not be used to launch scored inference.
